# Query Checklist

1. Read `rawdocs/SCHEMA.md`.
2. Read `rawdocs/<slug>/00-meta.yaml` and `memory/summary.md` first.
3. Read additional memory pages relevant to the question.
4. Answer with explicit distinctions between source fact and interpretation.
5. Save reusable answers into `outputs/` when they should outlive chat.
6. Append a log entry using `## [YYYY-MM-DD] query | <question-short-title>`.

Prefer citations that point back to `raw/<filename>.md`.
